raw.rationale: MK-0773 is a selective androgen receptor modulator with cytostatic rather than broadly cytotoxic activity, so at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is unlikely to produce lineage-selective killing; AR dependence is strongest in prostate cancer, which is not among the listed lineages, and breast cancer has only modest AR-related sensitivity. Thus probabilities are low across all listed lineages, with slight enrichment for breast and liver/urinary tract where AR or steroid-metabolizing pathways may matter.
